text:
Zoe Martinez: Partner asked if we can accept a "micro-bundle" for marketplace sandbox listing instead of full SOC/pen upload. can we formalize a micro-bundle checklist?
Kenji Sato: yes - low friction checklist idea: 1) SOC2 cover/attestation or attestation letter, 2) pen test executive summary + current remediation status, 3) minimal topology diagram, 4) primary security contact. redactions allowed.
Asha Varma: security constraints: presigned uploads only, TTL <= 7 days, server-side encryption required, no secrets/credentials. we tag listing as "sandbox-limited" until full evidence is provided (we'll require full reports before prod).
Derek Holloway: for hardware SIs add: firmware SBOM or firmware manifest + signing cert fingerprint. if partner can't provide certs, require a remediation plan and ETA. Also recommend file naming pattern: partner_shortname_artifact_YYYYMMDD.pdf
Zoe Martinez: can someone draft a sample micro-manifest we can give partners? also need the presign endpoint and who runs scanning.
Kenji Sato: sample manifest below (one-line JSON in message for automation consumers): `{ "partner": "Nimble HW", "type": "micro", "submitted_on": "2026-05-06", "files": ["soc2-attest.pdf","pen-exec.pdf","topology.svg","contact.txt"], "hw_files": ["firmware-manifest.json"] }`
Asha Varma: note - even if we accept micro, we run an automated malware scan + quick metadata check. security reviewer will do a 2 business-day triage. if critical issues found we block listing and request full reports.
UploaderBot: presign created: `s3://redwood-marketplace-temp/partners/3976548888-nimble/micro/`. presigns TTL 168h, SSE-S3. Upload portal: https://upload.internal.redwood/3976548888-nimble (auth required).
Zoe Martinez: owners/timeline: Kenji -> publish micro-manifest + sample email template (due Tue), Partner -> upload micro-bundle (due Fri), Asha -> triage review (2bd). I'll send partner-facing note once Kenji posts the template. thanks everyone :wave:
